subject: general
question: The Asian Games is also known as _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Asiad**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Asiad** is the other name for the **Asian Games**.
 
• The Asian Games is a continental multi-sport event held every four years among athletes from all over Asia.
 
• The event is recognized by the **International Olympic Committee (IOC)** and is the second largest multi-sport event aft
